mechanism: Starting point, not superiority proof: MAP-Elites keeps an archive keyed by user-chosen dimensions of variation and searches for good solutions per cell instead of returning one global best. Translated to the public surface, this trial proposes a construction-time coverage ledger over enumerable cells (rotation subfamily x feature family x measured depth), targeting the least-covered cell with bounded duplicate attempts, counting duplicates and depth rejections separately from completed evaluations, and checkpointing the policy RNG and history. Per-candidate leaf attribution is not a public API, so feature_attribution is recorded as unavailable with a reason rather than inferred from private attributes. The mechanism is a starting point for a preregistered campaign; it is not evidence that this policy beats random_weighted, and no measured comparison is claimed here.
baseline_comparison: Planned comparison only, no measured comparison is claimed. Matched baseline (installed genetic by default; random_weighted as the documented alternative, with no full GA benchmark claimed) versus the stratified template on the same era/config, seed set, and equal completed evaluator counts, isolated per signal_pool_name; compare get_search_stats rows grouped by function subfamily x feature subfamily and get_yield_analysis lifetime_yield_rate. Per-era segments only; no pooling across era boundaries.
acceptance_evidence: Preregistered hypothesis and direction; paired independent runs with matched budgets and seeds; equal-completed-evaluation comparison; coverage ledger checkpoints showing the targeted cells; complete trial inventory including abandoned runs; explicit missing-API gaps recorded.
known_unknowns: Per-candidate leaf introspection for yielded graphs is not a public API, so feature cells may be unobservable and feature_attribution must be recorded as unavailable rather than fabricated.
random_weighted exposes no public seed knob, so seed matching depends on surfaces that are not documented.
The public loader output of generation_core.generate_random_signal_expression lacks the internal data_params key it reads.
No full benchmark of any algorithm has run in this packet, so the installed genetic default is unbenchmarked and baseline behavior is unverified.
Live permissions, data availability, and behavior of the simulate_signal/SimulationHandle path are untested; no successful simulation is assumed.
